items.title: Luke Schiro Interview, 1967-12-05
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know, uh, you know Hank Kamen? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Hmm?

ctx.x: That was in, I think it was in the Coventon. It was on the 4th of July. And we had a spot job. It was on the lakefront right out there. I don't quite remember the name of the place. But before a big fight started, so the sheriffs had troops of Teague, the ass around Aunt Florida. Everybody out there was dancing with tears in our eyes. You know that when Hank... You had to quit a while. You had to quit for about an hour. Yeah. Until it all settled down. Yeah.

You know, uh, you know Hank Kamen? What's that? Hank Kamen, he's a clarinet and saxophone player. He's from the way. No. He played on the president every Saturday night, so... When he sings... When he sings... Did he get over?
